name: transient-edge-tables-repeated-names
body: artifacts/db.rs' TRANSIENT_EDGE_TABLES repeats the 23 table names — it must, to rebuild each Record variant from the DB. Limit: a second list duplicates load::tables::TASK_EDGE_TABLES. Upgrade when a fourth consumer appears: derive it from load::tables::TASK_EDGE_TABLES instead of repeating the names.
